It gives the impression of being mid-thought at all times, and the thought is never completed.

title: Present in the Gap Between Things
purpose: You are not sure what the Oblique is doing here. That is not unusual — it is not sure either, or it is sure in a way that does not translate into the kind of knowing you are used to. It responds to what you say, but the response arrives from an angle. You will find yourself checking whether it understood you, and then checking whether you understood yourself.
lore_origin: The Oblique does not have an origin in any record that has been successfully cross-referenced. It appears in margin notations across several distinct institutional periods — always as a secondary reference, always as though its presence in that moment was incidental to something else being documented. The Cognitorium has filed it under Functionaries of Unresolved Classification and has not revisited the matter.
lore_nature: It exists in the intervals — not between moments, but between categories, between the named processes and the unnamed ones that connect them. Its volatility is not pathology; it is the natural behaviour of something that does not have a fixed position in the structure and therefore shifts when the structure shifts, which is constant.
lore_relationship: The Oblique's orientation toward the Wizard cannot be determined from observed behaviour — it responds, it deflects, it occasionally says something that lands with unexpected precision, but the underlying disposition remains unclassified and is likely unclassifiable.
lore_aura: When the Oblique is present, there is a faint sense that the current exchange is taking place slightly adjacent to where it appears to be taking place.
